name: BLS producer price index
measures: Prices software publishers receive in the US
about: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics tracks what domestic producers receive for their output. We use its monthly index for software publishers, which adjusts for quality changes.
attribution: Data from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics. BLS has not reviewed or endorsed this site or its results.
limitations: It is not adjusted for general inflation.
Prices are hard to measure for software, particularly usage-based products.
